name: paired-seeds-3k
question: Over several seeds, does training-time large-Gaussian pruning (s1) change novel-view quality on the validation panorama relative to s0, and how many extreme Gaussians does it remove?
gate: run only if divergence.md shows identical settings, schedules, camera order and RNG states up to 3000 for both short/long pairs, and the determinism probe explains any remaining gap
design: paired: for each seed, s0 and s1 share everything except reset_every (large-pruning window i = 1100..2400); 6 seeds x 2 arms, 3000 steps each
seed_effect: the seed sets the camera draw order (torch.Generator) and torch.manual_seed; initialization is deterministic
prep_run: salon-gsplat-008: new preparation at the commit used for these trainings (the trainer requires the preparing code); same verified inputs and partition

metrics.primary: per-seed paired difference s1 - s0 of mean validation PSNR and SSIM at 3000
secondary: paired differences of validation region PSNR (glass, contours, furniture, mirror)
large Gaussians and out-of-box opaque Gaussians, s1 - s0
comparative sheet of the same validation faces for every seed

reading: report mean, standard deviation and sign count of the paired differences; no winner on mean PSNR alone; results limited to validation panorama R0010006
relation_to_ctrl: ctrl-3k-s0/s1 on salon-gsplat-007 are not reused: all pairs share one preparation and one commit
